Integration modifications (source bytes unchanged):
Model scale 0.7452205, file units/scale and axis conversion enabled; Medium mesh
compression, Read/Write off, imported normals, no tangents, welded/optimized mesh.
No animation import or Animator; no blend shapes, generated colliders, cameras,
lights or visibility. Custom maximum 4 bone influences. No runtime rig/motion claim.
One project-owned URP Simple Lit opaque material samples only the light albedo:
white tint, no metallic/emission/detail/normal/mask binding, 1024 maximum, sRGB,
mipmaps, bilinear, anisotropy 1, Android ASTC 6x6.
Normal and mask are retained unbound for provenance: max 1024, linear, mipmaps,
ASTC 6x6. Normal is imported as Normal Map without green inversion; its convention
has not been visually established. Mask preserves RGBA.
Resources/Characters/GuardianEntTree01.prefab is generated explicitly by the
QA-owned menu Realm Raiders > Art Intake > Build Guardian Ent Tree01 Pilot.
One identity root contains a Fit child at (0, +0.004083, 0), yaw 0, scale 1; source
bind transforms remain beneath it. No Collider/Rigidbody/Animator/scripts/Camera/
Light/AudioListener/Animation is permitted. Gameplay root/CharacterController,
health, possession, cultivation leaf tiers and combat timing stay unchanged.
The full primitive Guardian recipe is retained when the Resources prefab is absent.

PILOT ONLY — NOT PRODUCTION BUDGET ACCEPTANCE:
Offline FBX: 5,438 triangles, 2,721 control points, 31 deform bones, no LODs.
1,438 triangles above LargeCreature LOD0 cap 4,000; LOD1 2,000 / LOD2 800 absent.
373 source control points exceed 4 influences (maximum 8); importer pruning is
not equivalent to production weight cleanup. No source animation clips are used.
Imported bounds, forward direction, bind-pose rendering, material/submesh counts,
cultivation clipping and both mobile orientations require QA; device performance
and later animated deformation remain unverified. Never substitute Tree02/dark set.
